# PUE Calc

> Calculate your data center's power usage effectiveness (PUE) and DCiE, see what overhead costs per year, and train your team on energy efficiency, cooling optimization and monitoring.

PUE Calc (https://pue.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Energy Efficiency & PUE, Cooling Systems Design & Optimization, Monitoring, Automation & BMS, DCIM Platform Fundamentals training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://pue.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [Energy Efficiency & PUE Optimization](https://pue.hazwoperosha.us/courses/energy-efficiency-pue-optimization): $99.99 per seat, 4 Hours, PUE. Cut operating costs with a measurable PUE optimization roadmap. Enroll: https://pue.hazwoperosha.us/courses/energy-efficiency-pue-optimization?buy=832
- [Cooling Systems Design & Optimization](https://pue.hazwoperosha.us/courses/cooling-systems-design-optimization): $298.99 per seat, 8 Hours, PUE / ASHRAE Thermal Guidelines. Cut cooling costs and improve reliability with modern thermal management strategy. Enroll: https://pue.hazwoperosha.us/courses/cooling-systems-design-optimization?buy=841
- [Monitoring, Automation & BMS Systems](https://pue.hazwoperosha.us/courses/monitoring-automation-bms-systems): $276.99 per seat, 8 Hours, BMS / DCIM. Design a monitoring and BMS strategy that catches problems before they cause downtime. Enroll: https://pue.hazwoperosha.us/courses/monitoring-automation-bms-systems?buy=846
- [DCIM Platform Fundamentals](https://pue.hazwoperosha.us/courses/dcim-platform-fundamentals): $99.99 per seat, 4 Hours, DCIM. Understand DCIM strategy and build the ROI case for implementation. Enroll: https://pue.hazwoperosha.us/courses/dcim-platform-fundamentals?buy=830

## Guides

- [Measuring PUE properly](https://pue.hazwoperosha.us/guides/measuring-pue-properly): Where to meter, over what period, and the mistakes that flatter the number.
- [Quick wins to lower PUE](https://pue.hazwoperosha.us/guides/quick-wins-to-lower-pue): Changes that pay back fast, roughly in order of effort.
